title: Operator system
snapshot: Snapshot from the operator machine. Not a live feed. Nothing on a timer publishes this page.
lede: An assistant on this computer runs practice operations. The person remains the coach. This page is the map of that setup, and a template for a build that fits someone else's work.
footer: Unified Solutions. This page describes a system. It does not coach, and it does not hold client work.

parent.name: Parent operator
parent.detail: One Hermes install on this Windows computer. It can use files, calendar, and email on this machine. Those tools are fenced. The working mouth is Slack. Desktop and the terminal are the same assistant.

profiles.name: Parent
profiles.detail: The practice operator. Its own files, its own rules, its own mouth.
points: Does not attend sessions.
Does not replace judgment.
Client documents stay closed until a file is named, and then the read stays on this machine.

profiles.name: Second profile, same install
profiles.detail: A second profile lives under the parent install. It uses the same model login. It is not an isolated gift. Do not copy this pattern for another person.
points: Same computer user.
Same model login.
Same backup drift as the parent.

profiles.name: Isolated gift
profiles.detail: One gifted operator has a separate Windows login, a separate Hermes home, and separate keys. Last metal probe: green, gateway up (2026-10-26 15:55 CT).
points: Separate login on this computer, not a separate computer.
Disk is shared. The graphics card is not shared, by rule.
Parent keys, parent files, and parent conversations are not shared.
Their files sit on their own share. This snapshot did not open it.
Their name, talk, and keys are not on this page.

zones.name: Green
zones.rule: Practice business. No session content. No unnecessary client names. A cloud model is allowed.
points: Strategy, public writing, research on public material.
Prefer a role over a name when the name adds nothing.

zones.name: Yellow
zones.rule: Names, companies, and scheduling. Minimum only. A US cloud model may handle the admin task. It does not analyze the person.
points: A Chinese host does not get this.
Codes over full names when the work still gets done.

zones.name: Red
zones.rule: What was said in session. Assessments. Health, family, or legal material. Recordings. Client documents with the person's substance.
points: Local model, or the person. Not a cloud model.
Seeing a file is not permission to open it.
If a named file is unlocked, the read stays on this machine.
The rule is enforced by the operator. It is not a sealed vault.

model_rule: Closed means the company keeps the model and the text goes out. Open-weight means the model can run here and the text can stay. Where the text goes, and who trained it, are different tests. A router is not a fence.

models.note: Posts, site, decks, anything a stranger will read.
By hand. Green text only. It scores. It does not rewrite the voice.
Private path. Not the most capable path.

models.work: If the default brain is down
models.note: Written rule. See the gap above the fold.

models.leaves: Yes, to whatever model was picked
models.note: Not a backup. Not for private material.

houses.name: Practice files
houses.detail: One command folder. Sorted by kind of work: strategy, operations, finance, communications, research, data. Not by venture.

houses.name: Assistant runtime
houses.detail: Separate install. Settings, memory, sessions, and keys stay there. They are not filed with the business.

houses.name: Identity
houses.detail: The operator's own assessments. Drop, file, extract, synthesize. Not client files. Not opened unless he says so.

houses.name: Public site
houses.detail: Its own repository. Shipped apart from drafts.

houses.name: Projects and archive
houses.detail: The design said one folder per effort, then archive when done. Projects is not how the work is filed. Archive is empty.

houses.name: Side efforts
houses.detail: A personal note and a gifted-setup note sit inside the practice folders. That is a leak, not a second house.

rhythm.detail: Job prompts are not published. A name in a job is not a name on this page.
classes: Morning operations and a weekday research briefing.
Weekly strategy, finance, cost, and a Friday review.
Gateway health, and a nightly backup.
A metal check on the isolated gift. Up or down. Not their talk.
A daily cost pulse is paused on purpose. The weekly cost job remains.

transfers.name: They get
points: Their own install, their own keys, their own files.
A mouth they already use.
A zone rule matched to their work, not copied from a coaching code unless they are a coach.
A default closed model for the work, and a local model for what must not leave.
A steward who can see up or down, not their conversations.

transfers.name: They do not get

This personality.
A shared chatbot account.
A second profile on this install. That pattern is the one to avoid.

not_on_this_page: Client names, session content, and client files.
Other people's names, conversations, phone numbers, and files.
The private cockpit used day to day.

gaps.title: Do not claim the backup chain is clean
gaps.detail: The written rule is US Claude, then a local model. The live chain has an extra entry after Claude. It is labeled like a router and names a foreign model that is not installed as the local private path. The second profile on this install has the same entry. A mid-turn failover can send the whole conversation. Remove it or prove it dead before telling anyone the backup cannot leave the fence.

gaps.title: Do not claim the vendor keeps nothing
gaps.detail: Session content is not sent to a cloud model, by rule. Zero-retention on the cloud account has not been confirmed. The rule is not a vendor promise.

gaps.title: Privacy is a rule, not a sealed room
gaps.detail: There is no separate locked profile that makes a cloud call impossible. Disk encryption is still an open item on the checklist. Say that before calling the machine a vault.

gaps.title: Folders do not separate the ventures
gaps.detail: The house sorts by kind of work. Side efforts have leaked into those folders. Archive is empty. Do not describe this as one folder per business.

gaps.title: The private path is small on purpose
gaps.detail: Llama 3.1 8B fits the 10 GB card. It keeps text home. It is not a frontier model. A local answer without tools is continuity, not the operator.

gaps.title: The gift shares the computer, not the keys
gaps.detail: Isolation here is a separate login, a separate home, and separate keys. It is not a separate machine. The original bar was a separate host. This snapshot is the login pattern, and the gateway was up.

gaps.title: Session history is large
gaps.detail: The parent session store is over a gigabyte. Compacting it is an offline job, with the gateway stopped. It is not urgent, and it is not done.

gaps.title: A software update is waiting
gaps.detail: The parent install reports an update. It was not applied for this snapshot. Do not treat the version line as the latest release.
